Card Q&A.q: If my opponent has no Digimon in play or no Digimon with a level less than or equal to one of my Digimon, can I still use this card’s effect to delete 1 of my Digimon?

Effect: [Main] You may delete 1 of your Digimon to delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with a level less than or equal to the deleted Digimon's level.
Security Effect: [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon.
